Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for taking this. As part of the SIG/CAIQ intake, our assessor asked for a small sample set to validate your SDLC controls. Specifically they requested:  

- 3 representative pull requests showing code review comments, approvals, and merge timestamps (redact user emails if needed)

- Evidence of HSM/KMS rotation and custody (a rotation chronology or export is fine)

Can you provide the above by EOD Monday? If you prefer, a short narrative explaining where to find the artifacts in your repository/drive + 2-3 attachments would work.

Cheers,

From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com

Date: Sat, 23 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: quick assemble for Maple Bank assessor (see list)

Team —

Evelyn from Maple Bank requested a tight sample set for the SIG/CAIQ intake. I need a quick turn — delivery by EOD Monday. Please see the ask and ownership below:  

1) PR samples (Irene) — pull three representative PRs across service/workflow pieces. Requirements: include reviewer comments, approvals, CI status check, merge SHA and timestamp. Redact personal emails and any customer data. Deliver as a single unified patch or diff and a short index mapping PR -> repo/path.

2) CI runbook excerpt (Lauren) — 1–2 pages showing: gated merge checks, who can approve deploys (role names are fine), ephemeral credential creation flow, and rollback steps. Highlight the job names we run in CI and where secrets lives (KMS/HSM references are fine; do not include raw keys).

3) HSM/KMS rotation chronology (Jordan) — export of rotation events for keys used in the runtime (last 12 months). Include dates, rotation trigger (manual/automated), and custody owner. CSV is ideal. Redact exact key IDs if sensitive; the chronology and custody columns must remain.

Process notes:
- Put artifacts in the drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleDriveLink and mark with prefix MAPLE-AUDIT-202605
- I will perform a privacy pass for emails and customer identifiers before final delivery.
- If an attachment is large, provide a link instead and reference the exact files.

Irene —please take PRs and produce pr-sample-458.patch format like we discussed. Lauren/Jordan ping me on Slack if you hit any blockers.

Thanks,
Mateo
From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
